full_description: swap the left-side mouse and the right-side stapler
schema: {A} starts on the left, {B} starts on the right, and {a}/{b} are the left/right arms
seen: Use {a} and {b} to swap the positions of {A} and {B}.
Move {A} to {B}'s original spot and {B} to {A}'s original spot.
unseen: Trade the table locations of {A} and {B}.
Switch {A} and {B} without leaving either at the staging spot.
